prompt:
Hi, our compliance team needs a localized export of our Hungarian customer records for a regulatory audit. We have a raw CSV file at data/raw/customers_raw.csv containing customer birth dates, account balances, monthly incomes, phone numbers, and address components — all in a generic, non-localized format.

Please process this file and produce a new file called customer_report_hu.json in the workspace. Each of the 5 customers should appear as a JSON object with all fields properly localized for a Hungarian audience. The auditors are Hungarian and will reject anything that doesn't look like a genuine Hungarian document — dates, money amounts, phone numbers, and addresses must all follow the local conventions expected in Hungary.

The scripts and reference materials you need are already in the workspace under scripts/ and references/.
